THE EARTHQUAKE AND ITS ECONOMIC AND FINANCIAL IMPACT

On the 25th of April, 2015, a massive 7.8 magnitude earthquake hit Nepal, the

a 7.3 earthquake on May 12, caused over 8,700 deaths as well as widespread damage. The

GoN has identified 14 districts as the most affected and has concentrated its relief and

reconstruction efforts there. In the early days following the first earthquake, some 24,000
